faq.a: Kahraman is associated with the Persian form قَهْرَمَان, whose core sense is kahraman; hero (persian/turkish).

faq.q: What is the origin of Kahraman?
faq.a: Kahraman is associated with Persian. Kahraman is Persian قهرمان (qahramān), meaning 'hero'. It is used as a male given name in Turkey and Iran.
No — the underlying form is Persian, not Arabic.
Kahraman can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Persian-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
Kahraman should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. Qahramān is a Persian word, not a Quranic Arabic form.

faq.q: What does Kahraman mean in Urdu?
faq.a: In Urdu, Kahraman is rendered قہرمان and carries the sense قہرمان، ہیرو.

faq.q: What does Kahraman mean in Persian?
faq.a: In Persian, Kahraman is rendered قهرمان and carries the sense قهرمان، پهلوان.
A romanized syllable approximation is kah-ra-man. No IPA transcription is asserted because a verified phonetic transcription was not available.

faq.q: What are the variants of Kahraman?
faq.a: Romanization variants include Kahraman, kahraman. Script forms are قهرمان, قَهْرَمَان, قہرمان, क़हरमान.

faq.q: Is Kahraman a boy's or girl's name?
faq.a: Documented usage records this form as male. Gender is not inferred from the meaning of the word, and actual use may vary between communities.
